messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: I'm rolling a tiny refresh to the Quickstart HelloApp: switch examples to prefer REDWOOD_KEY, add explicit deploy step for Console tokens, and fix a couple of links. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/quickstart/pull/487 (WIP)

devon: SG. i'll pick up the SDK snippet changes. do we want the examples to show a fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY for backwards compat?

maria: yes please keep the fallback. goal is minimal churn. suggested node pattern:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/ft-1', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(out.text);
```

devon: nice. i'll convert the curl examples too. proposed curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/ft-1","prompt":"Hi"}'
```

lila: i'll update the quickstart repo .env.sample and the example repo README. also found one broken internal link that pointed to /docs/old-quickstart-path 1: will switch to /docs/quickstart/helloapp and add an anchors sanity check.

sachin: please add a short migration blurb: "REDWOOD_API_KEY still works; we recommend REDWOOD_KEY going forward." also add a note on token scopes in the docs (minimal: read/generate).

maria: good call. also want a small note near the deploy step: "Create a token in Console > API tokens and paste into .env (use REDWOOD_KEY)." attach a screenshot (1200px wide) in the PR.

devon: i'll add test coverage in the sdk/snippets folder: a tiny jest test that asserts the Authorization header is set to `Bearer <token>` when the env var is present (using mock fetch).

lila: pushed .env.sample update and a screenshot tweak in the quickstart draft. changed the image to 1200w and compressed it to <200kb.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-487--docs.redwood.ai (quickstart) :white_check_mark:

devon: reviewed the SDK snippet PR and left one nit about named exports. prefer `RedwoodClient` named import, not default. fixed in PR.

sachin: LGTM on wording. tiny security nit: avoid suggesting tokens in shared screenshots; blur the token value.

maria: added CHANGELOG entry under docs: "quickstart: prefer REDWOOD_KEY in examples; preserve REDWOOD_API_KEY fallback". Also opened a follow-up to add CLI example for token creation.

lila: assigning reviewers @devon @sachin. once SDK snippet and quickstart both have green previews i'll merge.

devon: approved SDK PR, added the jest mock test. will merge after quickstart preview is green.

maria: thanks. if the quickstart deploy preview fails, we may need to pin the docs rendering image plugin version. ping here if that happens.

lila: preview succeeded. merging now.

maria: merged both. will watch for any corrections. final follow-up: a small paragraph for non-dev users explaining where to find the Console token UI.

sachin: optional: add a sentence about rotation best-practices and KMS if we want to be enterprise-y.

maria: noted. closing thread. thanks everyone :tada:
